notes: Authoring recipes, not delivered art or shipped playable stages. e01/e02/e07 have independent richer sources. Each district and device intersection is a stable named site; choice results are stored per coordinate.

worlds.title: Morrow's Shift
worlds.visual: candid contemporary city in rain, warm ordinary gestures, anxious fey observer
worlds.thread: Morrow learns that work and friendship require repair rather than a spell

districts.name: Station Concourse
districts.scene: Trains obey printed timetables but the first ticket machine speaks in fees instead of riddles.
districts.stake: whether to accept help without owing a magical favor

districts.name: Research Annex
districts.scene: Morrow has been hired to check the numbers rather than charm the instruments.
districts.stake: who owns an error when the person wearing the face is new

districts.name: Public Library
districts.scene: The computer gives Morrow the answer but not the question that makes it useful.
districts.stake: the right to learn without pretending expertise

districts.name: Night-School Corridor
districts.scene: The class studies probability as if the future can be reasoned with.
districts.stake: whether to admit not understanding

districts.name: Community Kitchen
districts.scene: Soup is served by people who volunteer after an exhausting shift.
districts.stake: a meal freely given versus a favor demanded

districts.name: Riverside Flats
districts.scene: A neighbor carries groceries upstairs and waves to a person Morrow has never met.
districts.stake: being known by a name earned by somebody else

districts.name: Clinic Waiting Room
districts.scene: The queue has no royal privileges and every patient has an appointment number.
districts.stake: whose need is allowed to interrupt the rules

districts.name: Floodlit Night Park
districts.scene: The city is quiet enough for Morrow to try an impossible working.
districts.stake: whether magic has failed or Morrow has misunderstood courage

devices.name: Unopened Letter

devices.name: Broken Stopwatch

devices.name: Secondhand Coat

devices.name: Shift Roster

devices.warning: cover the shift and risk losing another promise

devices.name: Paper Cup
devices.intrusion: One steaming cup of tea sits across from an empty chair.
devices.warning: carry the tea to a worker who cannot leave their station

devices.name: Handwritten Map
devices.intrusion: A child's map describes the city with monsters where grown-ups see traffic.
devices.offer: follow the child's actual safe crossing
devices.warning: ask which frightening landmark the child needs renamed

worlds.title: The Unbelieving City

worlds.thread: The same streets turn dangerous; rescuing people matters more than proving the spell

districts.name: Station Concourse

districts.stake: whether a crossing should remain open at mortal cost

districts.name: Research Annex
districts.scene: A glass corridor holds a storm that has learned to count names.
districts.stake: emergency shelter before explanation

districts.name: Public Library
districts.scene: Unreturned books crawl home by themselves and lock the doors behind patrons.
districts.stake: public access rather than perfect containment

districts.name: Night-School Corridor
districts.scene: A lesson in probability has become an exam where wrong answers erase doors.
districts.stake: truth without impossible certainty

districts.name: Community Kitchen

districts.name: Riverside Flats
districts.scene: The apartment stairwell has grown a new landing every time someone says goodbye.
districts.stake: getting home without sacrificing strangers

districts.name: Clinic Waiting Room
districts.scene: The queue floats into the ceiling while medicine still needs refrigeration.

worlds.title: Scylla's Shore

worlds.thread: Scylla remembers the future while younger Char does not; the escape is genuinely hers to choose

districts.name: Council Gallery

districts.name: Coral Nursery
districts.scene: Small creatures live in borrowed shells nobody remembers lending.

districts.name: Oren's Supply Vault

districts.stake: honest logistical risk rather than romantic bravado

districts.name: Festival Court

districts.name: Tide Observatory

districts.stake: evidence that cannot be safely proven

districts.name: Servants' Jetty

districts.name: Hidden Landward Gate

devices.name: Borrowed Fins

devices.name: Moonlit Ribbon

districts.name: Festival Court

districts.name: Servants' Jetty
